name: Adi Gallia's first lightsaber
description: A lightsaber was built by 32 BBY and used by Jedi Master Adi Gallia, who served in the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. The lightsaber was destroyed during a mission sometime before the Invasion of Naboo. Gallia had constructed a new lightsaber by the invasion's end in 32 BBY.
